questions.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?

questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.cl0185 = 'SME', T2.cl0198, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cl0184) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.cl0185 = 'LAM', T2.cl0198, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cl0184), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.cl0185 = 'LAM', T2.cl0198, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cl0184) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.cl0185 = 'KAM', T2.cl0198, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cl0184), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.cl0185 = 'KAM', T2.cl0198, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cl0184) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.cl0185 = 'SME', T2.cl0198, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cl0184) FROM tb010 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb014 AS T2 ON T1.cl0184 = T2.cl0184 WHERE T1.cl0186 = 'CZK' AND T2.cl0198 = (SELECT MIN(cl0198) FROM tb014) AND T2.cl0193 BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
